component.name: ddcui-rs
component.summary: Control external monitor settings via DDC/CI

description.p: ddcui-rs is a Rust and GPUI reimplementation of ddcui. It communicates with a monitor's Virtual Control Panel (VCP) over DDC/CI to read and change settings such as brightness and contrast — the same settings and information exposed by the monitor's on-screen display.

It drives the ddcutil command line program, which talks to the monitor over a /dev/i2c device exposed by the video driver. DDC/CI must be enabled in the monitor's own menu, and the user needs access to the i2c devices.
This is an early port; not all features of the original ddcui are implemented yet.

A security and reliability release. Monitor writes now run on a background worker and are coalesced, so moving a level bar no longer waits for ddcutil; values that could not be re-read are marked as the last known ones; presets are written atomically and validated; and plugin installation validates every path from a manifest, refuses symlinks and stages the files before replacing an existing extension.
Desktop integrations are now installable plugins: the gnome-quick-menu plugin adds a ddcui button with brightness presets to the GNOME Quick Settings menu, right next to the power off button.

The brightness and contrast rows now have a draggable level bar: click anywhere on it to jump to that value, or press and drag to sweep. Brightness/contrast pairs can be saved as presets and reapplied with one click.
